en:
It would be a mistake to vote before
we've completely solved Angie's murder.

And there's still the mystery
of Tenko's murder...
Mystery? What kinda mystery?

Well, Kiyo's confession derailed our
conversation a bit...

but we still have to go over one of the
clues found at Tenko's crime scene.

I believe it might even have something
to do with Angie's murder.

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, the outlying piece of evidence
at Tenko's murder scene...

There was a cut on Angie's forehead
we haven't explained yet.
That's right. I wondered about that...

I think we need a closer look at the whole
situation, so we can find out what happened.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There was a bloody piece of tape
underneath Angie's body.
That's right. I wondered about that...

I think we need a closer look at the whole 
situation, so we can find out what happened.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The wooden statue from the seance—

That was used as a weight to keep the murder
weapon in place. Got nothin' to do with Angie.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

C'moooon, tell us the answer to this
mystery already!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Was there something strange about that?

I saw something under the floorboards
that bothered me when we investigated.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What clue was found at the crime scene
that hasn't been explained yet?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>bloodstain found under the floor<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Maki and I found it during the investigation.

It was beneath the floorboard
that the culprit stomped on.
Is that...Tenko's blood?

That bloodstain was too far from Tenko's
corpse to have been hers.

Also, the bloodstain was already
dry when we found it.

But the blood from Tenko's body
hadn't even begun to dry yet.

Well, that's weird. Why was that 
bloodstain the only dry one?

<CLT=cltMIND>The bloodstain under the floorboard
was dry because...
It happened before the seance
It was there before Tenko was killed

The blood was spilled before the
seance when Tenko was killed.

It dried faster because
the stain was smaller.

But that bloodstain was rather far from
Tenko's body, wasn't it?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
It was from the investigation

During the investigation, Kokichi hurt
himself on one of the floorboards...

I tripped through the floorboard in a different 
room, not in the room with the murder scene...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The air was dry

It was very dry in the room,
so the blood dried quickly.

Not possible. Tenko's blood on top of the
floorboards wasn't dry yet, remember?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

You don't understand? But you found it, Shuichi.
Gonta might not be able to help you...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The bloodstain under the floorboard
was dry because...

The bloodstain wasn't from Tenko's
murder...
It was there <CLT=cltSTRONG>before we started the seance<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Before the seance...?

<CLT=cltMIND>That should make it clear
whose blood it was...
Tenko Chabashira
The bloodstain came from Tenko.

Tenko wasn't injured before the 
seance, so that's probably wrong.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Angie Yonaga
Korekiyo Shinguji

The bloodstain came from Kiyo
from before the seance.

When he was setting up the seesaw,
he might have injured himself.

That wouldn't *not* be a possibility,
but that would be a super boring answer.
Give us an answer after you deducted better!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Kokichi Oma

Kokichi, you were injured during
the investigation, weren't you?

Uhhh...you serious? We even walked around
together before the seance began, remember?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Nyeh? If it was from before the seance, 
then whose blood is it already?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The bloodstain from before the
seance... It has to be them.

That bloodstain wasn't Tenko's.
It was <CLT=cltSTRONG>Angie's<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Nyeh!? Why was blood from Angie
at the scene of Tenko's murder!?
Yeah, wasn't Angie killed in her research lab?

Just because we found her body there, 
doesn't mean she was killed there.
Ah...I guess that's possible!

If Angie wasn't killed in her lab, then
that opens up a lot more possibilities.

We assumed that only council members could've 
killed Angie, since her body was in her lab...

But if she died somewhere else, then we can't
suspect just the council members anymore.

So the culprit didn't enter her lab, but
waited for her to come out of it?

I'm not sure if the culprit waited for her, but
they probably killed her when she came out.

Well, I thought that was more likely from
the start.

So I went to <CLT=cltSTRONG>places Angie might've gone<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
and checked all three empty rooms.

Places she might've gone? Why did you
check the empty rooms, then?

Hm? The empty rooms were the only places
I could think of that Angie would go.
Did...Angie have business in rooms?

Kehehe... It seems Kokichi's up to
his usual misleading nonsense again...

Nee-heehee... I do lie a lot,
and I could be lying right now too...

But, I'm pretty sure *someone's* panicking
right now because of my lie.

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie left her lab on her own and
headed to the room where she was killed.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is Kokichi's statement true?
Or...
